title: Ben and His Cat
text:
Ben has a cat. Her name is Luna. Luna is gray and she sleeps a lot. Every day, Ben gives Luna food and fresh water.

Ben also brushes Luna every week. She likes it very much and she purrs. When Luna is sick, Ben takes her to the vet. He loves his cat very much.

questions.text: What is the name of Ben's cat?
What does Ben do every week?
options: He takes Luna to the vet
He walks Luna in the park

questions.text: How does Luna probably feel when Ben brushes her?
Why does Ben take Luna to the vet?
options: Because Ben wants a new cat

paragraph_translations: Ben tiene un gato. Su nombre es Luna. Luna es gris y duerme mucho. Todos los días, Ben le da comida y agua fresca a Luna.
Ben también cepilla a Luna cada semana. A ella le gusta mucho y ronronea. Cuando Luna está enferma, Ben la lleva al veterinario. Él quiere mucho a su gato.
